messages:
Alex: Quick thread to align on cloud marketplace offer packaging + joint announcement runway with SI partner. Need SKU naming, artifact mapping (AMI/SIG/container), partner quote, and trial/EULA blurb. Can we lock by EOD?
Mei: AWS needs AMI ids and pricing CSV; Azure wants SIG refs; GCP wants container digest + productId. We'll keep a canonical CSV plus per-cloud mapping.
Jon: SKU suggestion: rwinf.<tier>.<units>.<region> e.g. rwinf.enterprise.1.us. Add columns: arch,gpu_profile,price_currency,trial_days,artifact_url,partner_logo_allowed.
Priya: AMI status: x86 AMIs in us-east-1/us-west-2/eu-west-1. arm64 in us-east-1 only. Uploaded artifacts: ami-rl-x86-202603, ami-rl-arm-202603, azure:sig-rl-pro:v5, gcr.io/redwood/rl@sha256:feedface. SBOM link posted.
LegalBot: Marketplace legal checklist: trial_days <= 14; short trial blurb required on offer page; DPA link must be attached for EU SKUs; include export control clause. Proposed blurb: "Try Redwood Inference free for up to 14 days. Cancel during the trial to avoid charges. Trial may auto-convert to a paid subscription unless cancelled."
partner-bot: SI partner assets uploaded: partners/si_xyz/logo_pack_v1.zip and partners/si_xyz/quote.txt (quote pending legal approval).
Alex: Action items: Mei publish canonical CSV template (today), Priya attach AMI/SIG/container digests + SBOM (EOD), LegalBot paste final EULA + DPA link (today), Alex will schedule 15m gating call after assets posted.
Mei: Uploaded CSV sample: ``sku,display_name,arch,gpu_profile,regions,price_currency,trial_days,artifact_url,partner_logo_allowed
rwinf.enterprise.1.us,Redwood Inference Enterprise - 1 unit,x86_64,a100,us-east-1|us-west-2|eu-west-1,USD,14,https://artifacts.redwood/skus/enterprise-1.json,true``
marketplace-lint-bot: Lint results: 2 warnings - missing DPA_attachment for eu SKUs; ambiguous arm region support. See /lint/1723334444-report.
Alex: We'll triage warnings on the call. If you can't make it, drop final items in the checklist and ping me. :rocket:
